Project.NAME: marktext-modernized
Project.keywords: markdown, editor, wysiwyg, electron, tauri, vue3, muya, macos, homebrew, port, modernization
Project.annotation: Phase-A (Electron 30 + Vue 3) and Phase-B (Tauri v2 + Rust) module graph. Phase-A retains upstream structure (src/main, src/renderer, src/muya, src/common) and is represented only by muya (M-012) and renderer (M-011) here. Phase-B introduces Rust backend modules M-001..M-010 plus the IPC bridge M-013.

M-001.NAME: mt-tauri-shell
M-001.purpose: Tauri app entrypoint; builds app, registers plugins, manages windows and lifecycle. Phase-B1 delivered 5 sub-modules covering boot-time guards, validation, security audit, panic recovery, lifecycle primitives, and the PDF-export contract surface.

sub-module.name: m001_validate
sub-module.purpose: BLOCK_VALIDATE_AGAINST_FIXTURE on-boot parity check (embedded tauri.v2.json vs REGISTERED_COMMANDS); native dialog + exit(1) on drift

sub-module.name: m001_security
sub-module.purpose: WebView shell security posture audit (CSP, freezePrototype:FALSE [inverted 2026-04-29 — Element Plus + Vue ecosystem requires writable Object.prototype; defense moves to CSP+DOMPurify], assetProtocol disabled, dangerousDisableAssetCspModification false); native dialog + exit(1) on regression

sub-module.name: m001_panic
sub-module.purpose: std::panic::set_hook installer + crash-log writer to cache_root/crash-{ts}-{chain}.log; re-entrancy-safe; never panics in handler

sub-module.name: m001_pdf
sub-module.purpose: mt::print_to_pdf MT_UNSUPPORTED stub; PDF export delegated to M-015 mt-pandoc-bridge per phase-b1-pdf-export-strategy.md

sub-module.name: m001_lifecycle
sub-module.purpose: CloseStateMachine (8 states), MenuGeneration AtomicU64, ReplayPolicy enum; types only at B1, runtime hooks deferred to B2/B3 (F-LIFECYCLE-WIRE, F-MENU-GEN-WIRE, F-REPLAY-POLICY-WIRE)

sub-module.name: m_v1_compat
sub-module.purpose: Tauri-side stubs for v1.2.3 IPC channels not yet ported to dedicated modules. Currently houses mt_window_state (titleBar/index.vue startup invoke). Each command has an F-V1-IPC-COMPAT-STUBS followup pointing at its long-term owning module.

fn-main.PURPOSE: Boot order: panic_hook → legacy detect → MARK_SKIP_MIGRATION env check → migration dialog (if needed) → security audit → fixture validate → tauri::Builder with M-013b + m001_pdf invoke handlers

fn-mt_print_to_pdf.PURPOSE: MT_UNSUPPORTED stub; lives at m001_pdf::mt_print_to_pdf — registered in main.rs generate_handler! alongside M-013b commands

fn-mt_window_state.PURPOSE: m_v1_compat::mt_window_state — returns {isFullScreen, isMaximized} from tauri::Window queries; replaces v1.2.3 main-process titleBar handler. Maps from renderer channel mt::window-state via shim hyphen→underscore translation.

fn-install_panic_hook.PURPOSE: m001_panic runtime entry; emits BLOCK_PANIC_HOOK_INSTALLED + (on panic) BLOCK_PANIC_HOOK_FIRED

type-CloseStateMachine.PURPOSE: Window-close lifecycle enforcement; 8 states + transition validator + 8 BLOCK_* markers per state

type-MenuGeneration.PURPOSE: AtomicU64 counter; bump_menu_generation/check_stale; emits BLOCK_MENU_GENERATION_BUMPED + BLOCK_STALE_MENU_GENERATION

type-IpcError.PURPOSE: m001_pdf-side UnsupportedError envelope; distinct from M-013b's MT_NOT_IMPLEMENTED — code MT_UNSUPPORTED

stub-ship-evidence.files-shipped: 5 sub-modules @ 1217 LOC + main.rs wiring (186 LOC); 11 #[tauri::command] handlers registered (10 m013b + 1 m001_pdf)
stub-ship-evidence.verification: cargo test --bin mark = 95 passed (47 baseline + 48 in B1: 7 validate + 7 security + 3 panic + 3 pdf + 14 lifecycle + 14 m013b); cargo build --release zero warnings; tsc --noEmit clean

M-010.NAME: mt-security
M-010.purpose: Backend security primitives: path sandbox (lexical + canonical, rejects traversal/symlink-escape/NUL/overlong), URL scheme allowlist (http/https/file: only; rejects javascript:, data:, vbscript:, mt://, tab/CRLF-smuggled variants), shell-open executable-extension blocklist. Renderer-side concerns (HTML sanitizer / KaTeX / Vega / punycode warning / shell.open user-confirm prompt) deferred to Phase-B3.

fn-check_path.PURPOSE: Reject NUL/overlong/traversal/symlink-escape; canonicalize when both paths exist; emit BLOCK_NUL_OR_OVERLONG / BLOCK_REJECT_TRAVERSAL / BLOCK_SYMLINK_ESCAPES

fn-check_url_scheme.PURPOSE: Allowlist http/https/file; strip control chars + whitespace before scheme parse to defeat tab/CRLF smuggling; emit BLOCK_SCHEME scheme=<name>

fn-check_shell_open_extension.PURPOSE: Block .command/.app/.scpt/.scptd/.lnk/.url/.desktop/.applescript regardless of sandbox; emit BLOCK_EXECUTABLE_EXT ext=<name>

fn-lexical_normalize.PURPOSE: Internal: fold . and .. against parent components without touching FS; returns None on root-escape

fn-extract_scheme.PURPOSE: Internal: pull scheme from URL string, control-char-stripped + lowercased

type-SecurityError.PURPOSE: 7-variant enum: NulByteInPath, OverlongPath, PathTraversal, SymlinkEscapesSandbox, DisallowedUrlScheme, DangerousShellOpenExtension, IoError. Display + Error impls.

const-MAX_PATH_BYTES.PURPOSE: POSIX PATH_MAX=4096 ceiling; rejected before any syscall

const-DANGEROUS_SHELL_OPEN_EXTENSIONS.PURPOSE: 8 entries covering macOS+Linux+cross-platform; Windows .bat/.cmd/.ps1/.vbs added when Windows port lands

stub-ship-evidence.verification: cargo test --bin mark m010_security = 23 passed; full suite 118 passed (95 baseline + 23 m010); cargo build --release zero warnings (after #![allow(dead_code)] for stub-surface acknowledgement, same pattern as m001_lifecycle)

coverage-vs-V-M-010.covered: scenario-2 file:// outside sandbox refused; scenario-4 path traversal rejected; scenario-7 case-fold partial (canonicalize-based); scenario-10 (BOM) NOT covered — renderer concern; ec NUL/overlong; ec symlink-escape post-canonicalize; ec URL schemes (8 categories); ec executable-ext.
coverage-vs-V-M-010.not-covered-renderer-side: scenario-1 (CVE-2023-2318 script tag) — DOMPurify renderer; scenario-3 (shell.open user confirm prompt) — needs Tauri runtime; scenario-5 (DOMPurify config parity) — renderer; scenario-6 (22 fixture-xss payloads) — renderer; scenario-8 (KaTeX javascript:) — renderer; scenario-9 (Vega expression) — renderer.
coverage-vs-V-M-010.not-covered-windows: ec Windows UNC + device-namespace; ec Windows case-fold traversal — both deferred to v2.1+ (Windows port).
